heading: Thursday Night
text: Partly cloudy early, then mainly clear. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s, except low to mid 20s in northern cold hollows. North winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly sunny. Valley highs mainly in the low to mid 50s, with mid to upper 50s in southeastern valleys, and some upper 40s far north. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the morning.

heading: Friday Night
text: Clear to partly cloudy. Lows in the low to mid 20s, with some upper 20s near Lake Champlain, and teens in northern cold hollows. Winds diminishing to light and variable.
